Higher Education Committee
Thursday, March 2, 2023
3:00 PMLivestream YouTube

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm

Call to order

S.F. 998: Senator Xiong: Student loan advocate establishment.

Motion that SF 998 be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Committee on Commerce Consumer Protection passed on a
voice vote

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved that S.F. 998, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Commerce and Consumer
Protection Committee.

S.F. 1709: Senator Fateh: Board of Regents and Regent Candidate Advisory Council modification.

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 1709, be laid over.

S.F. 1215: Senator Oumou Verbeten: Higher education institutions requirement to provide access to menstrual products at no
charge to students; appropriating money.

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved that S.F. 1215, as amended, laid over and may become part of omnibus bill.

The meeting was adjourned at 4:40pm
